detailed_design.setting: A preserved mill at dusk. Phantom workers repeat incomplete shifts across three rooms, with objects and remembered sounds as clues.
stages: Clock room: observe the ghost's arrival, bell, and tool sequence; replay the three events in order.
Dormitory: return a lunch tin, coat, and letter to the correct owners using portraits and spoken clues.
Mill floor: reconstruct the final handover from two rooms' evidence, illuminating a path to Elowen.
detailed_design.tactic: Elowen alternates Ghost immunities, debuffs, and physical attacks. A demonstration before entry explains that Normal and Ghost attacks cannot hit each other without explicit exceptions.
detailed_design.battle_rule: Normal singles with softly fading scene backgrounds. No invisible exits, hidden lethal traps, or deceptive battle targets.
detailed_design.reward: Reusable Ghost technique TM, Echo Badge, root-bridge restoration.
detailed_design.music: Music-box fragments gradually forming one complete melody
detailed_design.visual: Warm sepia memories against mist-blue mill interiors
detailed_design.rematch: A different worker's three-room memory; Elowen brings five Ghost partners.

detailed_design.title: The Ironroot Rail Forge
detailed_design.setting: A restored mine railway threaded through a working forge. The player dispatches unmanned ore carts, never rides moving unsafe carts.
stages: Loading yard: set points to send one cart to its weight-matched support track.
Switch chamber: park one cart in a siding while another passes; ghost carts follow a visible, repeatable schedule.
Forge span: distribute three ore loads so the bridge's labelled limits remain safe; unload to reveal Garrick's arena.
detailed_design.tactic: Garrick focuses on high physical Defense, predictable switching, and Steel secondary types. His ace has a fourfold Fighting weakness, offering a deliberate breakthrough.
detailed_design.battle_rule: Normal singles. Cart errors reset only the current cart; no HP damage or full-puzzle restart. A forge rest bench offers free healing before the leader.
detailed_design.reward: Reusable Steel technique TM, Forge Badge, pressure-gate release.
detailed_design.music: Hammer percussion, low brass, and rail rhythm
detailed_design.visual: Rust-red mine walls, silver rails, and orange forge windows
detailed_design.rematch: Four carts with intersecting schedules; Garrick brings five industrial partners.

detailed_design.title: The Steamglass Conservatory
detailed_design.setting: Calderpost's geothermal greenhouse, divided into fern, orchard, and alpine growth chambers around a central steam tower.
stages: Demonstration loop: send heat to one chamber while keeping its gauge inside the displayed safe band.
Shared manifold: move a limited heat budget between the three chambers; the sum stays constant and gauges update immediately.
Night cycle: insulate one pipe and reopen a return valve to stabilize all chambers, unveiling Suri's sunlit arena.
detailed_design.tactic: Suri deliberately sets battle Sun through a legal move once available; her mixed Fire partners use Fairy, Poison, and Rock coverage. Sun must be earned by a turn, not imposed indefinitely.
detailed_design.battle_rule: Normal singles; successful puzzle insulation has no combat stat bonus. No real-time pressure timer; steam is visual and does not cause overworld damage.
detailed_design.reward: Reusable Fire technique TM, Ember Badge, safe vent-crossing access.
detailed_design.music: Bright strings with valve clicks and pulsing bass
detailed_design.visual: Warm orange steam, emerald plants, and pale volcanic glass
detailed_design.rematch: A new heat-budget constraint; Suri brings five Fire partners.

detailed_design.title: The Glacier Rescue Academy
detailed_design.setting: A Frostford rescue station around a tabletop glacier and an indoor simulated snowfield with ropes, route flags, and emergency shelters.
stages: Map room: read wind arrows, snow-load symbols, and crevasse marks; place three waypoints through the safe corridor.
Practice snowfield: follow those waypoints while helping two volunteers reach marked shelters; turn-based steps advance scripted weather, never real time.
Dispatch final: choose shelter, rope anchor, and crossing order for a convoy; after the simulation succeeds, Ansel challenges the full party.
detailed_design.tactic: Ansel combines Ice attackers with rescue-support partners rather than pretending the roster contains five different nonlegendary Ice species. Snow setup and clear switch telegraphs teach planning; Hearthika provides warmth-themed Fairy support.
detailed_design.battle_rule: Leader roster: Slabalanche Lv54, Fortimber Lv53, Grudgerine Lv54, Hearthika Lv54, Borealice Lv56. The badge remains Ice-themed; three non-Ice rescue partners are disclosed before battle. Full heal before the leader; simulation setbacks never injure Pokémon.
detailed_design.reward: Reusable Ice technique TM, Glacier Badge, Whitevault expedition briefing.
detailed_design.music: Rising orchestral march, wind bells, and a reassuring shelter motif
detailed_design.visual: White-blue practice snow, red rope anchors, and gold rescue flags
detailed_design.rematch: A whiteout scenario with new safe-route clues and a six-member rescue team.

legendaries.title: The First Hunter
legendaries.lore: Preserves scent trails as ice. An apex hunter following a migration older than the modern forest, not an evil animal.
legendaries.ability: Cold Instinct: The user cannot be frozen. On entry into active battle Snow, its Attack rises one stage once per entry. Later weather changes do not retrigger it; suppressed weather does not qualify.

legendaries.hidden_ability: Lightning Rod: Reuse Generation IX battle rules; complete effect fixtures pending.

legendaries.signature: Verdant Current: Water, special, 85 power, 100 accuracy, 10 PP; after damage restores one eighth maximum HP to the user.

legendaries.hidden_ability: Water Absorb: Reuse Generation IX battle rules; complete effect fixtures pending.

legendaries.signature: Pressure Forge: Fire, physical, 90 power, 100 accuracy, 10 PP; ignores target positive Defense stages.

legendaries.hidden_ability: Flash Fire: Reuse Generation IX battle rules; complete effect fixtures pending.

abilities.name: Herd Shelter
abilities.effect: The user cannot be frozen. During battle Snow, its first super-effective damaging hit after each entry is reduced by 25%. The protection is spent only when qualifying damage occurs. No second activation until it leaves and re-enters.
abilities.rationale: Dreadmoth's herd silhouettes briefly protect it; its Fighting weakness remains dangerous.
abilities.implementation_status: Design specification only; resolver hooks and tests pending.

abilities.name: Living Canopy
abilities.effect: On entry, heals the user and every other adjacent conscious ally for 1/8 maximum HP, minimum one. Once per battle per creature instance, not once per switch; never revives, heals benched Pokémon, or triggers on weather changes.
abilities.rationale: Pelagrove provides a travelling nursery without enabling unlimited switch-loop healing.
abilities.implementation_status: Design specification only; resolver hooks and tests pending.

abilities.name: Furnace Plates
abilities.effect: The user cannot be burned. On the first damaging contact hit it receives from a foe per entry, roll a 30% chance to burn the attacker, respecting immunities. The attempt is spent regardless of the roll; no per-strike rerolls on multi-hit moves.
abilities.rationale: Cindervault's furnace armour is protective but does not stack several extra defenses.
abilities.implementation_status: Design specification only; resolver hooks and tests pending.

abilities.name: Quiet Witness
abilities.effect: The user cannot be confused. Opposing effects cannot clear or reverse its positive stat stages; opposing Haze still resets its negative stages and other creatures normally. User-caused resets or drops still apply. Does not prevent ordinary stage reductions or damage.
abilities.rationale: Hushveil preserves built-up memories without becoming immune to every debuff.
abilities.implementation_status: Design specification only; resolver hooks and tests pending.

abilities.name: Deep Time
abilities.effect: The first super-effective damaging hit after each entry is reduced by 25%. It cannot stack on that hit with an identical first-super-effective-hit reduction; stronger protection takes precedence and only the effect actually used is spent.
abilities.rationale: Stratovar's layered strata become its hidden defensive option; Intimidate remains its normal ability.
abilities.implementation_status: Design specification only; resolver hooks and tests pending.
